subject: Security & audit trail capability follow-up: API event exports and immutability options
messages:

Hi Elena — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so your procurement/security teams have a single reference: 

Summary of what we covered: 
- Redwood supports per-account admin activity and API event logging (create/update/delete, policy changes, token usage, model inference metadata).
- Exports can be delivered via S3 (preferred for large exports) or as time-windowed JSON/CSV bundles from our exports API.
- We have options for retention hold / immutability for Private deployments (S3 Object Lock / WORM) and signed audit bundles for Hosted.

Open items you asked us to confirm: 
1) SOC 2 status and timing — we are in the process of finalizing our latest Type II attestation; estimated availability is mid-June. I will attach the attestation status doc.
2) GDPR/HIPAA coverage — Redwood provides Data Processing Agreements and can sign BAA; we can walk through scoping for HIPAA-covered workflows.
3) Vendor security questionnaire — happy to kick this off. If you can send your questionnaire (or a CSV/Doc), I’ll assign Priyom to own the technical responses.
4) Audit export immutability — we can provide a recommended design (S3 Object Lock for Private) and a signed manifest approach for Hosted.

Proposed immediate next steps: 
- Elena: share the vendor questionnaire and procurement checklist you want us to use (if available).
- Redwood (Priyom): provide a short technical addendum describing export formats, retention primitives, and immutability options.
- Redwood (me): schedule a 30-min follow-up demo of the export flow (deliver to S3 + verify signatures).

Attachments: Redwood_Audit_Export_Specs.pdf (high-level export formats & API endpoints)

Thanks — I’ll loop Priyom on the technical follow-up.

Best,
Rafael

Hi Elena — looping in a few technical details to answer your questions point-by-point. I’ll take the VQ and populate the technical sections. Notes below are intended to be copy/paste-friendly for your questionnaire.

1) Export formats & delivery: 
- We support export snapshots via our Admin Exports API (/v1/admin/audit/exports) producing NDJSON, newline-delimited JSON, or compressed CSV bundles (.csv.gz).
- Delivery options: S3 direct delivery (configured per-account with presigned write role), HTTPS fetch endpoint for smaller payloads, or secure SFTP for customers that require it.
- Max bundle size: 50GB per export file; we recommend time-windowed exports (daily/hourly) for large workloads.

2) Retention and immutability: 
- Private deployments: we support S3 Object Lock (governance/compliance modes) and can configure a WORM retention policy at the bucket prefix level.
- Hosted: we provide signed audit bundles (SHA256 manifest + timestamped signature) and immutable audit indices for the duration of your retention window. For legal WORM guarantees for long-term retention procurement may insist on Private deployment with Object Lock.

3) Tamper evidence & provenance: 
- Hosted signed manifests include per-file hash and a server-side signature; we can also publish attestation events to a signed ledger for cross-checking.
- Optionally, we can provide a Merkle-tree style chain of hashes on request for higher assurance.

4) GDPR/HIPAA & encryption: 
- Data-at-rest: AES-256; Data-in-transit: TLS1.2+/mutual TLS when configured.
- KMS: customers may use Redwood-managed KMS or bring-your-own-key (BYOK) via AWS KMS / GCP KMS for Dedicated/Private.

5) Operational runbook for exports: 
- We will produce a runbook (export schedule, verification steps, replay instructions, S3 bucket policy sample) and attach as part of the VQ response.

6) API-level logging: 
- API request/response metadata, model selection, model version, token counts, and client metadata are included in event records. PII is redacted by default from stored logs; we can support additional redaction policies on request.

I’ll start answering the VQ today and flag any items that need legal review. Rafael — I can attach a short technical addendum to the questionnaire and the runbook.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai
